endpoints.name: Create Plan

Data access uses stored procedure(s): sp_GetUserWeeklyKpiSummary. Persists changes to: weaklyPlannerDetails: DELETE, weaklyPlannerProjectDetails: DELETE, weaklyPlannerHeaders: INSERT, AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid WeekId is required. [when request.WeekId <= 0]; Valid SelectedUserId is required. [when request.SelectedUserId <= 0]; Selected user not found. [when selectedUser == null]; Invalid WeekId. [when weekItem == null]
